blocks.text: Researchers tasdeeq (confirm) karte hain ke pehchana gaya target waqai bimari mein ahem kirdar ada karta hai. Experiments kiye jate hain taa ke yaqeen ho ke is target par asar karne se ilaaj wala (therapeutic) asar mil sakta hai.
